'''''Bidens triplinervia''''' is a [[Latin America]]n species of flowering plants in the [[Asteraceae|sunflower family]]. It is native to [[Mesoamerica]] and [[South America]], from [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]] State in northern [[Mexico]] to [[Jujuy Province]] in northern [[Argentina]].<ref>[http://biogeodb.stri.si.edu/herbarium/species/?spnumber=547 ''Bidens triplinervia''.] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150528201220/http://biogeodb.stri.si.edu/herbarium/species/?spnumber=547 |date=2015-05-28 }} Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute Herbarium.</ref><ref>Cabrera, A.
